    """Overlay the two 4x5 panels: mark occupied cells as 3."""
    separator = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 4 for v in row))
    upper = grid[:separator]
    lower = grid[separator + 1:]
    return [[3 if a != 0 or b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(top, bottom)]
            for top, bottom in zip(upper, lower)]
